svg.text: ENGINEERING TRAINING MODULE · USB-C / PLATFORM POWER · AI-ASSISTED HYPOTHESIS · REV B
HP USB-C Dock G5 → Windows business laptop · charging kept working · USB, Ethernet, displays gone — dock absent from Device Manager · restart did not help · ≈45 s hold fixed it
AI-assisted analysis · the explanation is a HYPOTHESIS, not a confirmed root cause · representative architecture, varies by model.
PCB MOTHERBOARD · WHERE THE STATE LIVES

svg.aria-label: PCB-style laptop motherboard, mode DOCK FAILURE
svg.text: Representative modern business-laptop architecture — exact implementation varies by model. Red = suspected area (hypothesis).
USB-C SIGNAL PATH · ONE CONNECTOR, THREE JOBS

svg.aria-label: USB-C connector cutaway: power works, USB data and DisplayPort missing
svg.text: USB-C receptacle, viewed face-on · 24 contacts · three independent jobs
POWER · VBUS + CC (PD messages ride CC)
USB 3 or DisplayPort, set by the mux
SBU1/2 → DP AUX in Alt Mode
Plug is reversible: CC tells the controller which way round it is,
then the mux maps TX1/RX1 or TX2/RX2 to the right destination.
Charging shows VBUS + CC + PD were working.
It says nothing about the data and display paths.

text.tspan: Observed: power stayed up; not even USB 2.0 enumerated. Hypothesis: the stuck step sat before
data AND display, most likely the USB connection / data-role state the PD controller reports.

svg.text: VOLTAGE DECAY · WHEN STATE IS ACTUALLY LOST

svg.aria-label: Rail voltage decay after regulator is disabled, with retention threshold
Proposed mechanism: Windows restart versus hardware power-state reset
svg.text: AUX rail feeding PD / mux logic
AUX rail feeding PD / mux logic
V(t) = V₀·e^(−t/RC) · state survives until the rail crosses the retention threshold

svg.text: USB-C REINITIALISATION · CC → PD → ALT → USB → OS

svg.aria-label: Normal USB-C dock bring-up sequence, ten stages
svg.text: Representative order · USB 2.0 can enumerate as soon as VBUS is up; DP and USB 3 wait for Alt Mode

g.text: Rp/Rd seen on CC1 or CC2 → flip known
pin assignment C or D · orientation
AUX over SBU · clock recovery · EQ

svg.text: No documented procedure needs 45 s; all documented thresholds are ≤ 40 s. 45 s most likely = margin, not magic.
Observed: after the reset every function returned, consistent with the chain re-running from stage 1.

Side exits: not charging → charger / cable / PD · USB OK → display path only · dock visible in Device Manager → Alt Mode / lane path · restart fixes it → driver / OS state · reset fails → hardware fault
Sources: ACPI 6.5 §4.8.2.2.1.3 · HP Support “Perform a power reset” · HP USB-C Dock G5 datasheet + SoftPaq firmware notes · Dell KB 000139016, 000125880 · Lenovo HT510479 · Microsoft Support 4036280
